newsitem.title: USA: SFX clarifies Multi-Market warrant terms.
newsitem.headline: SFX clarifies Multi-Market warrant terms.

text.p: SFX Broadcasting Inc, to clarify any possible misunderstanding about the conversion of Multi-Market Radio Inc warrants, said on Tuesday each outstanding Class B Multi-Market warrant entitled the holder to buy 0.2983 of one share of SFX common stock.

SFX Broadcasting and Multi-Market completed their merger on November 22, with Multi-Market Class A and Series B preferred shareholders receiving 0.2983 shares of SFX Class A common stock for every Multi-Market share held.
Shareholders of Multi-Market Class B common stock and of original preferred stock received 0.2983 shares of SFX Class B common stock for every Multi-Market share held, they said.
Each outstanding Multi-Market Class B warrant entitled the holder to buy 0.2983 shares of SFX common stock at an exercise price of $11.50, SFX said on Tuesday.
To buy one SFX common share, a holder would have to exercise 3.3523 SFX Class B warrants for an total purchase purchase price of $38.55 cash, SFX said.
If the average closing price per SFX common share for 20 consecutive trading days exceeded $53.64, the SFX Class B warrants could be called for redemption at $0.01 per SFX Class B warrant, SFX said.
